added.content: Working through why he keeps losing the London by move 15, Damon committed to trying the aggressive kingside plan (f4, Rf3, Rh3, queen swing) for ten games, then landed on the real insight mid-session: he's better in endgames than middlegames, so the actual plan is trading into endgames, not the kingside attack -- the attack is only for when they won't trade.
